name: Mapbox
description: Mapbox's hosted server geocodes places, plans routes and renders static maps with your Mapbox account.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp.mapbox.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
